subject: Maths
title: SOH CAH TOA — finding sides
subtitle: Trigonometry · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can use trigonometric ratios to find unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles.

key_vocab.definition: To find an unknown side, label the sides (O, A, H) relative to the given angle, then use the appropriate ratio: SOH, CAH, or TOA.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can use trigonometric ratios to find unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: unknown side -- To find an unknown side, label the sides (O, A, H) relative to the given angle, then use the appropriate ratio: SOH, CAH, or TOA.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Label sides O, A, H. Choose the ratio involving the known side and the unknown side. Rearrange to find the unknown.
opp = hyp × sin θ
Similarly: adj = hyp × cosθ, opp = adj × tanθ

Key examples:
  ✓ hyp = 10, angle = 30°: opp = 10 sin 30° = 5  (multiply hyp by sin)
  ✓ adj = 6, angle = 45°: opp = 6 tan 45° = 6  (multiply adj by tan)
  ✓ opp = 8, angle = 30°: hyp = 8 ÷ sin 30° = 16  (divide by sin)
  ✗ opp = hyp ÷ sinθ  (opp = hyp × sinθ)
  ✗ sin 30° = adj/hyp  (sin = opp/hyp, cos = adj/hyp)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – finding the opposite
  Angle = 30°, hypotenuse = 12. Find the opposite.
  Need opp, have hyp and angle: use sin
  sin 30° = opp/12
  opp = 12 × sin 30° = 12 × 0.5 = 6
  opp = 6
  (Multiply the hypotenuse by sin of the angle.)

Example 2 – finding the adjacent
  Angle = 60°, hypotenuse = 10. Find the adjacent.
  Need adj, have hyp: use cos
  cos 60° = adj/10
  adj = 10 × cos 60° = 10 × 0.5 = 5
  adj = 5
  (Multiply hypotenuse by cos.)

sections.title: Finding opposite (using sin)
sections.content:
Find the opposite side.

(a) hyp = 10, angle = 30°
(b) hyp = 8, angle = 45°
(c) hyp = 14, angle = 60°
(d) hyp = 20, angle = 30°

sections.title: Finding adjacent (using cos)
sections.content:

(a) hyp = 12, angle = 60°
(b) hyp = 16, angle = 45°
(c) hyp = 6, angle = 30°
(d) hyp = 24, angle = 60°

sections.title: Finding hypotenuse
sections.content:
Find the hypotenuse.

(a) opp = 4, angle = 30°
(b) adj = 5, angle = 60°
(c) opp = 6, angle = 45°
(d) adj = 9, angle = 30°

sections.title: Using tan
sections.content:
Find the unknown side using tan.

(a) adj = 5, angle = 45°. Find opp.
(b) opp = 8, angle = 45°. Find adj.
(c) adj = 4, angle = 60°. Find opp.
(d) opp = 10, angle = 30°. Find adj.

sections.title: Mixed problems (1 dp)
sections.content:
Find the unknown side. Round to 1 dp where needed.

(a) hyp = 15, angle = 35°. Find opp.
(b) adj = 7, angle = 50°. Find opp.
(c) opp = 9, angle = 40°. Find hyp.
(d) hyp = 20, angle = 55°. Find adj.
(e) adj = 12, angle = 65°. Find hyp.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ opp = hyp × sinθ
✗ opp = hyp ÷ sinθ
✓ adj = hyp × cosθ
✗ sinθ gives the adjacent side
✓ hyp = opp ÷ sinθ
